The security-review specialist returned PASS for the bounded delta from 549bb717d539bd8bb37a981274497d18d7a217af. Review covered the new report.version/report.verified binding to the installed after-version, mismatch handling/output, and associated changes for new injection, executable-seam, environment, record-write or privacy regressions. No introduced security vulnerability was reported. Round 1 had no outstanding security finding; no new C34 hardening follow-up is raised. Functional closure of R261-001 and stale-report repro evidence remains with the correctness reviewer.

C33 assumptions are unchanged: same-user control of environment-provided executables, repository files and installed CLI is trusted; the updater is not a per-seat privilege boundary or credential sandbox.

Validation: exact detached HEAD verified clean. just pr-freeze 261 returned FINAL with remote/GitHub agreement, main base, CLEAN merge, ready, unchanged migration numbering and passing CI check (22), check (24), rust-lint, rust-test and Delivers. No local tests, builds, cargo commands, dependency installations, updater execution, credential-file reads or global-config changes were performed for this round. In particular, real copilot update was NEVER run. The prior-head SDK canary result is not claimed as a new-head run.

Known limit: static security delta review and CI/finality verification only; updater success/failure paths were not locally executed. This is a security verdict, not permission to update or reload fleet seats.
